review_candidates.description: Description Do you want to be part of a team of builders, directly responsible for the expansion and upgrade of Amazon network across MEATR (Africa, Middle East and Turkey) region? This Engineering Project Management role requires versatile and technical individuals with strong Ownership to deliver impactful results within: Multiple Business segments: The role will support both Amazon Fulfillment and Sort Centers (FC/SC), Delivery Stations (DS), Sub-Same-Day (SSD) and Quick Commerce (QC). Different Project types: The role will support both new launches (Greenfield), as well as retrofit of our existing buildings (Brownfield). Large engineering scope: The scope for this role is focusing on automation technologies (conveyance, sortation), Good-lifts (VRC) and Storage solutions (Pick Tower, Pallet racks, High Racks). E2E Project lifecycle: This role will own End-to-End project lifecycle for the above-mentioned systems. From business requirement to Go-Live, including concept design, budget request, vendor selection, detailed engineering, planning, execution, testing and qualification. During pre-execution phase, the PM has 2 main responsibilities. (1) They are expected to develop the overall operational site design on CAD, influence building selection and building size, and define the technologies required to achieve capacity requirement. Their design will account for Operations, Safety, Maintenance, Engineering highest standards, while remaining optimized and frugal, aiming to design the most efficient buildings at Amazon (2) Specifically for MHE, Storage and goods-lift Systems, the PM is expected to own their E2E delivery, including developing the detail design and specify technical requirements; secure the budget (i.e. $50MM); run RFP with procurement teams; decide vendor selection; benchmark cost efficiency with Finance teams; understand individual pieces of equipment, their application, benchmark performance, propose innovation and value engineering. In case of retrofit project within existing Amazon facilities, the PM is also expected to build the complete business case, demonstrate financial viability of the project, and prepare integration of new system within existing building without Operational disruptions. Upon Go-live, the PM provide support to the Operations and maintenance team to ensure adoption of best practices and track, report performance of the systems, and take corrective action if needed. Collaborate closely with various internal teams such as Construction, Operations, Reliability Maintenance Engineering, Procurement and Change Management Responsible for contractor management & teams above 300 people in construction site Become Subject Matter Expert for a specific piece of technology/equipment used at Amazon, advising Engineering teams internationally. For this experienced project manager role there is a high level of autonomy to manage the projects E2E and develop versatility. The role will be based in Cairo, between construction sites and corporate office, with expected travel within the MEATR region, up to 50% per year. CVP Optimization: Use data and analysis to refine our Consumer Value Proposition, focusing on selection, affordability, and overall customer experience. Market Intelligence: Monitor competitor moves and market trends to inform strategic planning and stay ahead of the curve. Strategic Reporting: Own the reporting for growth and CVP metrics, providing the business with the data needed for evidence-based decision-making. Go-To-Market Execution: Lead the local rollout of cross-functional initiatives, ensuring effective coordination across all departments. Analytical Prowess: Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and a track record of using data to drive commercial outcomes. Experience with Looker is a strong plus. Commercial Mindset: A pragmatic problem-solver who can navigate ambiguity and prioritise effectively in a high-growth environment. Effective Communicator: Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and coordinate complex teams. Financial Literacy: A good understanding of P&L dynamics and financial modelling is preferred. Industry Background: Experience in marketplace, consumer tech, FMCG, or consulting is highly desirable. Why Join Us? At Deliveroo, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving. We’re Food Lovers, Problem Solvers, Community Builders And More, Brought Together By a Shared Drive To Make Things Better. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong. We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief. If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!
